in_sanskrit.name: Saharuk
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है The One Who Has The Power Of The God Indra
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Saharuk एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Saharuk is a name derived from Sanskrit and Hindi language. It is a compound name, composed of two words, saha meaning 'with' and ruk meaning 'power'. The name Saharuk signifies 'The One Who Has The Power Of The God Indra'. Indra is the Hindu deity of rain, thunderbolts, and the warrior god of the Vedic pantheon. In Hindu mythology, Indra is the king of the devas (gods), and he is often depicted as the wielder of the thunderbolt, the lord of the heavens, and the god of rain.
